title: OpenClaw Autonomous Coding Agent: Fix Bugs and Open PRs While You Sleep
summary: OpenClaw autonomous coding agent reviews PRs, fixes GitHub bugs, and opens pull requests 24/7. Complete developer setup guide with real automation examples.
body_markdown: Self-hosted OpenClaw runs on your machine or a VPS — you manage Docker, updates, restarts, and uptime. Blink Claw hosts your agent in a managed cloud environment from about $45/month per agent, plus model usage billed from your workspace credits. The agent runs 24/7, gets security patches automatically, and you can message it from Telegram, Discord, or Slack. No infrastructure work required. For most developers, the monthly fee saves dozens of hours of DevOps overhead annually.
